subject: Literature
subcategory: Classic Novels That Changed the World
title: One Thousand and One Nights and Global Storytelling
description: A fast breakdown of One Thousand and One Nights and Global Storytelling for builders.

hook.text: A woman saved her own life by telling stories so captivating that her executioner kept postponing her death.

buildup.text: One Thousand and One Nights compiled tales from Persia, Arabia, India, and Egypt over many centuries.

discovery.text: Aladdin and Sinbad became globally famous after a French translator added them in the early 1700s.

twist.text: Many of the most famous stories were never in the original Arabic manuscripts at all.

climax.text: The collection pioneered the frame narrative and proved that storytelling itself can be an act of survival.

punchline.text: Stories literally kept their storyteller alive.

quiz.question: What surprising fact about One Thousand and One Nights is true?
options: All stories were written by one author
Many famous stories like Aladdin were not in the original manuscripts
It was originally published in English
